{{Short description|Uniform tiling of the hyperbolic plane}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U54_1}}
In [[geometry]], the '''tetrapentagonal tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>1</sub>{4,5} or r{4,5}.

== Symmetry==
A half symmetry [1<sup>+</sup>,4,5] = [5,5] construction exists, which can be seen as two colors of pentagons. This coloring can be called a ''rhombipentapentagonal tiling''.
:[[File:Uniform tiling 552-t02.png|240px]]

== Dual tiling==
The dual tiling is made of rhombic faces and has a [[face configuration]] V4.5.4.5:
:[[File:H2-5-4-rhombic.svg|240px]]
